title: Sune
scramble: R U2 R' U' R U' R'
story:
<!-- Case: Ortega-OLL-1 -->

## Overview
Sune on a 2×2: one oriented corner on top and the remaining three follow a clockwise flow.

## Recognition
- Exactly one yellow corner faces up while the others wrap clockwise.
- Small L-shape of yellow on the front-right side.
- First layer remains solved from Ortega Step 1.

## Technique
1. Run `R U R' U R U2 R'` (Sune).
2. Maintain orientation and transition straight into PBL.

## Fingertricks
- Anchor your right thumb on the front sticker so repeated R turns stay tight.
- Use the `U2` as a breathing point to refocus on upcoming PBL recognition.

## Common Mistakes
- Mixing it up with Anti-Sune and running the algorithm backwards.

## Practice
- Drill Sunes back-to-back until you can execute without cube rotations.

## Related Cases
- [Ortega-OLL-2](deddal://case/Ortega-OLL-2) – Anti-Sune mirror.
- [Ortega-OLL-3](deddal://case/Ortega-OLL-3) – U/Headlights pattern.

## Pro Tips
- Label this case “clockwise flow” during practice to avoid confusing it with Anti-Sune.

title: Anti-Sune
scramble: R U R' U R U2 R'
story:
<!-- Case: Ortega-OLL-2 -->

## Overview
Anti-Sune on 2×2: one corner solved, but the remaining pattern flows counter-clockwise.

## Recognition
- One yellow corner faces up, but the adjacent ones form an inverted L (mirror of Sune).
- Headlights appear on the left instead of the right.
- First layer stays intact from step one.

## Technique
1. Execute `R U2 R' U' R U' R'` (Anti-Sune).
2. Move straight into PBL once orientation is complete.

## Fingertricks
- Emphasize the opening `U2` to set spacing.
- Keep the right thumb against the front face for stability.

## Common Mistakes
- Re-running Sune muscle memory and making the case worse.

## Practice
- Drill Anti-Sune immediately after Sune so you can toggle between the two.

## Related Cases
- [Ortega-OLL-1](deddal://case/Ortega-OLL-1) – Clockwise sibling.
- [Ortega-OLL-3](deddal://case/Ortega-OLL-3) – Headlights case.

## Pro Tips
- Verbally note “anti” or “counter” before executing to prevent muscle-memory mistakes mid-solve.

title: U / Headlights
scramble: F R U R' U' F'
story:
<!-- Case: Ortega-OLL-3 -->

## Overview
Headlights/U case: two adjacent corners already face up while the other pair form headlights on the back.

## Recognition
- Two yellow corners together on the front, two twisted headlights on the back.
- From above it looks like a U shape framing the unsolved stickers.
- Easy to confuse with a solved top—double-check the back pair.

## Technique
1. Run `F R U R' U' F'` to orient the remaining corners.
2. Proceed to PBL.

## Fingertricks
- Lead with the left index on `F` so right-hand grip remains stable.

## Common Mistakes
- Assuming the layer is solved because the front looks correct.

## Practice
- Pair this case with Sunes to ensure you can spot the difference quickly.

## Related Cases
- [Ortega-OLL-1](deddal://case/Ortega-OLL-1)
- [Ortega-OLL-2](deddal://case/Ortega-OLL-2)

## Pro Tips
- Because this case is short, plan your PBL AUF during the final `F'` close.
